findings.direct_evidence: _runner_match proves only that a raw observed row equals the locked_runner_record supplied on that call. derive and sealed verification accept runner, paths, and ports as ordinary caller arguments. begin_issuer_run accepts only ledger and run_id, so the ledger session is not bound to an independently initialized runner authority context.
findings.security_consequence: A caller can select another real row and supply matching runner fields, then recompute under that substituted root. The frozen fake-runner test does not establish an authority source independent of the caller.

findings.direct_evidence: _canonical_ports accepts any unique caller list whose set is a subset of CONTROLLED_PORT_UNIVERSE. It does not require exact equality with all five controlled ports.
findings.security_consequence: An empty or reduced port set can remove 5038, 5554, or other protected ownership evidence and weaken candidate or veto derivation.

findings.direct_evidence: _listener_map validates PID and port value syntax but does not require every listener owner PID to resolve to exactly one identity in the fused process universe.
findings.security_consequence: An unknown, reused, or ambiguous owner of a controlled port may be retained in the listener map and then silently ignored during per-row candidate derivation.

findings.direct_evidence: Candidate reasons are collected before ancestry is checked. For every candidate-like row, observed ancestry nodes are added to support_identities regardless of the complete flag, and all candidate_set identities are emitted into project_authorization_candidates regardless of whether the chain reaches the selected runner.
findings.security_consequence: A candidate-like row with an incomplete or wrong-root chain remains in the authorization candidate view, while partial ancestors can be misclassified as support and cause false authority or false veto behavior.

test_sufficiency_verdict.reason_not_to_execute: The frozen matrices do not establish a non-caller-substitutable authority root, exact full controlled-port lock, listener-owner membership in the fused universe, or complete-root ancestry as a prerequisite for candidate/support projection.
